name: plushcap
description: Analyze developer and AI trends and competitor content for technical marketing research.

interface.longDescription: Plushcap provides content research and analytics for technical marketing teams. Use it to analyze developer and AI topic trends, compare competitors' publishing activity, and find sources for content planning. Search engineering blog posts, YouTube videos, and X posts indexed by Plushcap; compare companies and competitive spaces; and inspect Hacker News attention and historical trend metrics with links to sources. Requires a Plushcap account and authorization. Available sources, history, and usage limits depend on your account's plan. The integration is read-only; indexed coverage may be incomplete or delayed.
defaultPrompt: Find recent engineering blog posts about AI agents.
Compare Cloudflare and Vercel's blog, YouTube, and Hacker News activity over the last three months.
Which developer topics are trending across tech company blogs?
